courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 張拉膜屋蓋成形
related.titleEn: Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs
related.transfer: 可遷移「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」與「風洞試驗與雷諾數效應」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；張拉膜屋蓋成形的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "A dome that is not a dome: net and mast system" and "Wind-tunnel testing and Reynolds-number effects" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護；張拉膜屋蓋成形則以由預應力平衡求膜面形狀，經雙軸試驗、裁片補償、展開吊升與分階段張拉，把膜屋蓋做成不積水、不鬆弛的曲面為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep; Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs centres on finding membrane shapes from prestress equilibrium, then biaxial testing, compensated patterns, hoisting and staged tensioning to build roofs that neither pond nor go slack, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「徑向索網與 12 支桅桿」與「邊索垂度與膜預應力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到張拉膜屋蓋成形，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「安裝後的膜張力量測與驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Radial net and 12 masts” and “Edge-cable sag and membrane prestress”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Form finding and erection of tensile-membrane roofs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.

Using "Post-installation membrane tension measurement and acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.difference: 本課聚焦以 12 支約 100 m 桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成的輕量索網屋蓋，及其風吸力、索夾與膜片維護；索網屋蓋張拉則以以預拉力賦予索網勁度：鞍形索網與輪輻式屋蓋的張拉策略、力與幾何雙重控制、頻率法驗證與長期索力管理為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on A lightweight cable-net roof of 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-glass fabric: wind uplift, clamps and panel upkeep; Cable-net roof tensioning centres on giving cable nets stiffness through prestress: tensioning strategies for saddle nets and spoked wheels, dual force–geometry control, frequency checks and long-term force management, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

以「以振動頻率量測索力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Radial net and 12 masts” and “Prestress and geometric stiffness”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋
history.text: 千禧巨蛋由 Richard Rogers Partnership 設計，Buro Happold 擔任結構與機電工程顧問，McAlpine 與 Laing 聯合承攬，1997 年 6 月開工，屋頂結構在約 15 個月內完成，造價約 4,300 萬英鎊。它以 12 支約 100 m 高的桅桿、約 70 km 鋼索與 PTFE 玻纖膜構成，屋面原規劃為 PVC 聚酯膜後改為 PTFE 玻纖膜，膜材由 Chemfab 供應、Birdair 安裝，並獲英國皇家工程院 MacRobert 獎。展覽於 2000 年結束，2007 年改建為 The O2 重新開放，2022 年風暴 Eunice 撕裂數個膜面區段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。
history.textEn: The Millennium Dome was designed by Richard Rogers Partnership with Buro Happold as structural and services engineer and built by a McAlpine–Laing joint venture; work began in June 1997 and the roof structure was delivered in about 15 months for about £43 million. It combines 12 masts about 100 m high, about 70 km of steel cable and PTFE-coated glass fabric; the roof, first planned in PVC-polyester, was changed to PTFE-glass supplied by Chemfab and installed by Birdair, and the project won the Royal Academy of Engineering MacRobert Award. The exhibition closed in 2000, the building reopened as The O2 in 2007, and Storm Eunice tore several fabric segments in 2022. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.

history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「不是穹頂的穹頂：索網與桅桿系統」到「從千禧展館到 The O2：再利用與交接」改寫為 40 個原創分析、試驗與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿、設計圖或現場程序。

courses.connection: 從「倫敦千禧巨蛋屋蓋」的材料、構件、施工或監測延伸到下列公司、業主與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies, owners and institutions related to the materials, members, construction or monitoring of Millennium Dome roof. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.

vendors.name: Buro Happold
vendors.business: 工程顧問，長期從事索網與膜結構的形狀尋找、分析與設計。
vendors.businessEn: Engineering consultancy with long experience in form finding, analysis and design of cable nets and membrane structures.

vendors.name: Birdair
vendors.business: 張拉膜結構專業承包商，提供 PTFE 玻纖、ETFE 等膜屋面的設計協助、製作與安裝。
vendors.businessEn: Tensile-architecture specialist contractor providing design assistance, fabrication and installation of PTFE-glass, ETFE and other membrane roofs.
